#### PPA - Std Tab

The PPA - Std tab shows closed and current values at standard conditions, as well as prior period adjustments, if any were made.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 632;height: 255;" />

The following items are available on this tab:

- **Effective Date** - The date for which the data is applicable. This is dependent on contract day, contract hour and resolution. For hourly resolution, the effective date will be the day and hour the data is effective for. For daily resolution, the effective date will be at the contract hour for the given day. For monthly resolution, the effective date will be at the contract day and hour for the given month.
- **Activity Code** - This column will display whether or not any of the activity codes enabled under [System Rollup Configuration](../../Settings%20Manager/System/Rollup%20Configuration.md) are present for the device for a given period. The column will be highlighted an amber color if it is populated by anything and the code associated with the activity record(s) will appear. Right-clicking on a row will display the code and the associated trigger at the bottom of the context menu.
- **Closed Volume** - The volume reported for the meter or location at closing for the specified time.
- **PPA Volume** - The adjusted change in volume recorded for a meter or location after it has been closed.
- **Adjusted Total Volume** - The total PPA volume plus rollup volume. The current volume reported for the meter or location for the specified time. This is the value after all adjustments have been applied to the closed volume.
- **PPA Energy** - The change in energy recorded for a meter or location after it has been closed.
- **Adjusted Total Energy** - The current energy reported for the meter or location for the specified time. This is the value after all adjustments have been applied to the closed energy. The total PPA Energy plus rollup energy.
- **Closed Mass** - The mass reported for the meter or location at closing for the specified time.
- **PPA Mass** - The adjusted change in mass recorded for a meter or location after it has been closed.
- **Adjusted Total Mass** - The current mass reported for the meter or location for the specified time. This is the value after all adjustments have been applied to the closed mass.
- **Completion Status** - Indicates whether or not there is missing data. If there is no missing data for the time span, the completion status will be complete; otherwise, the completion status will be incomplete.
- **GMS Date** - The date that the data was written to the database.
